objective: Execute all phases of the original SQLite migration plan and open a pull request after all implementation and verification steps.
constraints: One authoritative SQLite operational writer; retain files only for human configuration, assets, attachments and explicit interchange.
Preserve protocol hashes, lifecycle rules, claims, authority and public errors.
Do not migrate live project data or publish a release.
Preserve the original checkout and its task state; implement in the isolated worktree.
risks: Interrupted cutover and WAL backup correctness
stopConditions: Required product behavior or acceptance facts remain unresolved.

verification.text: Full SQLite lifecycle, migration/restore, contention, tamper, CLI/API/MCP and required regression gates pass.

successCriteria.text: Every definition-of-done item in docs/SQLITE_MIGRATION_PLAN.md is implemented and evidenced, including sole writer, removed obsolete code and measured performance and LOC.
